name: Tokoya
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood barbershop (Midori Tokoya): a cut-fee change notice, a first day working part-time at reception, an hours-and-fees guide, a reservation system's switch from phone to app, a first-timer's manners guide, a lesson in rephrasing the difference between two cutting tools simply, a reservation mix-up and the lesson it teaches, the shop's history of switching from a paper reservation ledger to an app, a multi-use discount-ticket guide, a column on the debate behind allowing SNS posts of finished haircuts, a hybrid paper-stamp-plus-app point-card guide, a reflection on balancing speed and care as quick-cut chains spread, and a fortieth-anniversary report. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
